feedback.message: Bounded real HTTP lowering succeeds with existing G9 records/rules/EffectIntent plus host-owned listener handle; no HTTP-specific core syntax is justified yet. Preserve v1 token-in-code hash instability as a negative result and test two-backend differential lowering next.

Effect authority separation survives Goodman review. Concrete implementation should use opaque typed host resources plus sandbox/runtime enforcement; raw source capability names or metadata never suffice.

Future Clay Harness HTTP/effect fixtures should include missing/forged-handle denial, deterministic generated-target identity, inherited/opaque resource success, concurrent state receipts and ambient-authority escape tests.
Current trigger rename clay -> clayresearch is not synchronized into research_interconnect_preflight.py priority tables; official mesh preflight is fail-closed.
HTTP probe reinforces ordered/idempotent receipt needs but does not justify new UnifiedDB semantics or physical consolidation.
Network service authority remains outside graph activation/relevance; no ClayGraph change proposed.
HTTP execution does not alter GWT selection/readout semantics; effect/outcome remains a distinct receipted stage.
Probe preserves semantic-vs-physical topology distinction but adds no new higher-order coupling claim.
Concurrency success is not emergence evidence and creates no emergence claim.

evidence_strength_note: Cross-branch routing increases discoverability only; shared ancestry and parallel worker agreement are not independent replication.
